@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M4BXVEFR6J7MM3HRQFQX1D6K
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8580'
+title: 'Documents: messages between a run and its caller'
+---
+## What
+The documents must agree with the new operations `send agent` and `send caller` (alias `send parent`), and with the messaging tool that each run with a caller gets.
+
+Files:
+- `plan.md`:
+  - :38-49: replace "A run gives one final message, as mail" with this rule: a run can send messages to its caller while it works, and it gives one final message when it ends.
+  - Replace "Only its final text comes back" and "No follow-up into a finished run" with this rule: a caller can send a message to a run that is still running. A run that ended gets no message, and the call gives an error.
+  - §9.1 (table at :487): add `send agent` and `send caller` and the `parent` noun synonym.
+  - §9.2 (:516-531): message mail starts an answer, the same as a final message. `mailOnlyAnswerLimit` and `mailDeliveryPaused` apply to it.
+  - §9.3: the messaging tool for a run with no `Agent` grant or at `maxDepth`.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/FoundationModelsAgents.docc/DelegatingWithTheAgentsTool.md`: the six ops, with one example of each new op.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsAgents/FoundationModelsAgents.docc/TheFinalMessage.md`: messages before the final message.
+- `README.md`: the op list, if it has one.
+- `docs/skills-and-agents.md`: the access rule (each run with a caller can send messages to it).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] No document says that only the final text comes back, or that a run gets no follow-up.
+- [ ] Each document that lists the ops of the `agents` tool names all six.
+- [ ] The DocC catalog builds with no warnings.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Update `Tests/FoundationModelsAgentsTests/DocumentationTests.swift` (the claims at :138-141): each op, `send agent` and `send caller` included, is named on the tool article. Add a claim for the `parent` synonym.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter DocumentationTests` passes.
+- [ ] `swift package generate-documentation --warnings-as-errors` (or the CI DocC step) passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd`: write the failing tests first, then do the implementation until they pass.
\ No newline at end of file
